title: Work
subtitle: Pick a folder and describe the task: Nicx drafts a plan, you approve it, and it works on the files in that folder on its own while you do something else.
hint: E.g.: "put the invoices in this folder into a spreadsheet", "write a Word report summarizing these PDFs", "organize the files by type".
loadFailed: Couldn't load the tasks. Is the Nicx server running?
createFailed: Couldn't start the task. Try again.
pickFailed: Couldn't open the folder picker. Paste the folder path instead.
restartServer: Restart the Nicx server to use Work mode.
planning: The local model is drafting the plan… This can take 30 s to 1.5 min on this PC.
question: Nicx wants to delete something and needs your confirmation:
interrupted: Nicx closed in the middle of this task. You can resume where it stopped or undo what was done.
undone: Done: the folder is back to how it was before the task.

form.requestPlaceholder: What should Nicx do in this folder?
form.oneAtATime: One task at a time: wait for the current one to finish or stop it.
form.safety: Nicx only touches the chosen folder, keeps a copy of what it changes (so you can undo) and asks before deleting anything. Password and key files are left out.

plan.hint: This is the plan. Edit, remove or add steps and approve it so Nicx can start.
plan.emptyStep: Write every step or remove the empty ones.
